# Version 4.157.0
> **Skia m157 rendering reliability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.157.0-rc.2.26563.19)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.157.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.157.0 brings Skia m157 with rasterization, text, and GPU correctness improvements. The cumulative line also corrects filtered-image sampling and mask-filtered glyph handling. LibraryImport declarations explicitly use cdecl; the public managed API remains unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

- **Check Graphite Metal deployment targets** — Graphite Metal now requires iOS or tvOS 15; its macOS minimum remains 12. Raise lower deployment targets before using this backend, and continue to honor any higher managed or framework requirements. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542))

## Engine

- **Skia m157 with raster and glyph-replay corrections** — Updates the native engine and fixes convex antialiased path rasterization across vertical clip gaps, coverage-mask clamping, and direct-mask glyph replay validation. Graphite readback also uses the correct A-to-RGBx transfer stride. ([#5542](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5542), [#5612](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5612), [#5630](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5630))

## Bug Fixes

- **More reliable GPU geometry and text** — Corrects reflected hairline square caps, transformed ellipse and rounded-rectangle geometry, text-atlas selection, and stale atlas work after empty flushes. Graphite counts pending clips and skips draws whose clip stacks cannot fit a fresh render pass. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5688](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5688))
- **Filtered images and regenerated glyphs** — Prevents unrelated texels bleeding into antialiased or multisampled image subsets under minification and skew, and aligns filter-cache equality with hashing. Mask-filtered glyph reloads now respect changed paths, compatible mask formats, and full embossed-plane strides. ([#5770](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5770), [#5748](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5748))
- **Vulkan synchronization and displacement precision** — Adds a targeted device-loss cleanup delay for affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers and propagates synchronous fence-wait failures inside native submission. GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offset arithmetic now matches fp32 filter bounds. ([#5670](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5670), [#5710](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5710))
- **Explicit cdecl for LibraryImport** — Generated LibraryImport declarations now match existing DllImport calling conventions across SkiaSharp, HarfBuzzSharp, and related bindings, addressing a potential Windows x86 ABI mismatch. The reported optimized-call stack-growth symptom still needs Windows x86 runtime validation. ([#5565](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5565))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200

HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.200 makes LibraryImport calling conventions explicitly cdecl. This package revision retains native HarfBuzz 14.4.0.

## Release Candidate 2 (November 13, 2026)

Release Candidate 2 corrects transformed GPU geometry, stale atlas work, and Graphite clip-capacity handling. It also improves displacement precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait reporting without adding a managed result.
